meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 把仓库里堆积的 GitHub issue 按共同根因归并成少数「计划主 issue」,每个主 issue 配一份 plans/ 设计文档;子 issue 用统一评论引流后标为 not planned 关闭,再用一个 PR 整簇关掉。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20+ 开放 issue 且多为同源重复,或你要求 triage、合并、去重 issue 时触发;新提的 bug 也会被判断归属。

say.text: 把重复的 issue 按根因合并成几个 plan
say.note: 会建计划主 issue,并关闭子 issue

say.text: 这个新 bug 属于哪个已有的 plan?
say.note: 会在对应主 issue 下加 Round 评论并关闭它

say.text: 给 plan-02 出个 PR,一次关掉它名下所有 issue
say.note: PR 用 Closes #N 自动关闭子 issue

howto.what_en: Claude groups a GitHub issue backlog by shared root cause into a few plan-master issues, each mirrored as a plans/ design doc, closes children with a standard redirect comment, and bundles one PR per cluster that closes all of them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a tracker has piled up dozens of reports sharing the same defects, or when asked to triage, consolidate, cluster, dedupe issues, or route a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Consolidate the duplicate issues into a few plans
say_en.note: Opens plan masters and closes children.

say_en.text: Which existing plan does this new bug belong to?
say_en.note: Adds a Round N comment, closes the child.

say_en.text: Ship a PR that closes everything under plan-02
say_en.note: PR uses Closes #N to auto-close children.
